VBO:0201063.summary: Friendly and keen to explore in his keeper’s account, Dash is an adult Poogle who enjoys meeting people, walks and hikes. This Beagle–Poodle cross also includes Abigail, whose owner describes her learning sit, down and stay for rewards as a youngster and enjoying car rides.
VBO:0201063.shortDescription: A Beagle–Poodle cross, with named dogs described as keen on people and hikes or responsive to rewards and fond of car rides.
